person: a cousin you grew up with
shape: the first time you look after someone who used to look after you, in one small everyday way

slides.text: you were only two years older, but you always knelt down on the mat to untie my wet laces.
you picked at the tight double knots with cold fingers, and never once told me to hurry up.
so i spent years thinking wet shoes were just something someone knelt down to solve.
but yesterday you fell asleep on the sofa at seven in the evening, after twelve hours on your feet.
you didn't even make it out of your heavy work coat before your head dropped.
so i knelt on the rug, loosened the stiff laces, and eased both boots off by the heel.
i set them straight against the wall, because [[it was finally my turn to bend down]].

caption:
we grew up sharing a bedroom floor and hand-me-down coats.
it takes twenty years to notice when the person who looked after you gets tired.
send this to the cousin who always untied your knots first.

#growinguptogether #childhoodmemories #childhoodfriends #nostalgia
alt: A seven-slide story about growing up with an older cousin who untied your muddy laces as a child, and gently taking off their work boots after they fall asleep on the sofa years later.
